chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Muawiya ibn Hukaym, who said: 'I heard Uthman al-Ahwal saying, I heard Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) saying.'
'There is no medicine but it stirs up an illness, and there is nothing in the body more beneficial than restraining the hand, except for what is needed for it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the most beneficial practice for physical health according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) highlights the principle of moderation in health, noting that while medicine is necessary, it often introduces new ailments as side effects. He identifies 'restraining the hand' (from excessive eating) as the most beneficial practice for physical well-being, emphasizing that dietary restraint is superior to pharmacological intervention, except when strictly necessary for sustenance.
